_comment: Ordered candidate lists: the first candidate that is visible wins. Any Playwright selector engine works (css, text=, role=, xpath=, '>>' chaining). Keys starting with '_' are comments. 'pattern_*' keys are Python regular expressions applied to the text of a report-history row. To fix a broken run, put the working selector at the TOP of the named key; no code change is needed. Check every key with: uv run python run.py --inspect-report
_verification_status: VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE = verified on 2026-10-20/21 against the live Amazon Ads reporting/history page and Amazon sign-in pages by the sibling Amazon_ad_campaign_report_cron project (a Campaign report, same reporting console). They have NOT yet been confirmed against this account's Search Term report page. UNVERIFIED = best guess, confirm with --inspect-report.
_note_terminal_login: VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE (live Amazon sign-in and two-step pages, campaign project). Used only by 'run.py --login' on a host without a display: the email/password come from .env and the person types the two-step code in the terminal. Scheduled runs never sign in.
_note_reporting: UNVERIFIED. Shown on https://advertising.amazon.com/reporting once signed in; used only to confirm --login finished. The URL check (no /ap/ sign-in path) is the primary signal.
_note_history: VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE: reporting/history?entityId=...&reportId=... shows 'Close report', an 'Actions' dropdown (Run, Copy, Delete) and an AG Grid with columns Report status | Date created | Report period | Sent to | Actions, newest first. A pending run shows 'Processing' and '-' in Actions; a finished run shows 'Completed' and a 'Download' link. Without entityId the page shows 'Sorry, something went wrong'.
_note_run: VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE: the run entry is the menu item 'Run' inside the Actions dropdown, anchored to the exact word so it can never match Copy or Delete. run_report_button is an UNVERIFIED fallback in case Amazon adds a standalone button.
_note_confirm: UNVERIFIED: no confirmation dialog was seen on the live page; kept in case one appears.
_note_rows: VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE: data rows of the run-history grid. Header rows must not match.
_note_download: VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE: a 'Download' link inside a finished row. Always evaluated INSIDE the row matched to this execution's run, never page-wide.
_note_patterns: Applied to a history row's text, e.g. the live text 'Completed Oct 20, 2026 2:00 AM PDT Today - Download' (VERIFIED-ELSEWHERE format). pattern_created_at must expose a named group 'ts' and optionally 'tz' (a timezone abbreviation). Status words for failed/pending runs other than 'Processing' are UNVERIFIED.
